meta.name: Penn State strategic plan
meta.about: How HAX meets Penn State's strategic plan, generated from strategic-plans.json (a snapshot of https://strategicplan.psu.edu/engage/ read 2026-11-11). Only the objectives HAX meets are shown, each linked to the pillars, parts, UN goals and wins behind it. A&A's Strategic Plan 2030 opens from here.

psuplan.desc: Penn State's strategic plan, limited to what HAX meets: 7 objectives under 3 priorities, plus Growing (Inter)disciplinary Research Excellence, Transform Internal Operations, which HAX meets through A&A's plan or directly. Objectives HAX doesn't meet are left out. A snapshot read 2026-11-11.

pp_success.desc: Prepare students to be engaged citizens, employable, further educated, and able to drive positive change.

pp_research.desc: Use the University's scholarship to address major challenges facing the Commonwealth, the nation and the world. HAX meets this through A&A Goal 4: arts and design as research and practice.

pp_landgrant.desc: Contribute to the Commonwealth's economic development, workforce growth and overall vitality.

pp_deib.desc: An inclusive environment where all students, faculty and staff can flourish.

pp_tio.desc: The supporting element: initiatives that provide the infrastructure and support to carry out the plan's goals. The plan lists no objectives for it; HAX does more with less, and A&A Goal 1 aligns to it.

po_o1.desc: Advising, research advising, mentoring and class experiences that prepare students for their academic and professional futures. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

po_o2.desc: Co-curricular experiences that align students' passions, aptitudes and ambitions and lead them to success in school and work. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

po_o3.desc: Student, faculty and staff health and wellness, cultivated in a caring community focused on flourishing. HAX is the platform behind the Learn to Flourish Hub's public site. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

po_o6.desc: Use the University's assets and strategic partnerships to build resilient, sustainable communities for Pennsylvania. hax.psu.edu is a shared asset: the Innovation Hub's site and the LaunchBox small-business training site started there. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

po_o7.desc: Extend the academic enterprise through partnerships with business and industry, non-profits, communities and residents. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

po_o8.desc: Galvanize an engaged and effective network of advocates and investors in Penn State. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

po_o9.desc: Address institutional barriers to close student outcome gaps. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

aaplan.desc: The College of Arts and Architecture's plan (2026–2030). Each of its five goals aligns to a Penn State priority, in A&A's own words. Open it to see the sub-objectives HAX meets.
